parts.title: The Village by the River
parts.text: Long ago, in a village nestled between green hills, there lived a young girl named Aarav. She was known for her **noble** heart — always honest and quick to help others. The villagers were **frugal**, so each year they painted prayers on stretched **canvas** before the harvest instead of buying costly statues, and Aarav's paintings were the most beautiful of all, made to **gleam** in the morning light with threads of gold.

parts.title: The Gathering Storm
parts.text: One afternoon, dark clouds rolled in and a terrible storm struck the village. Chloe, the village elder, said it was **unusual** — she had never seen rain so fierce in spring. The **barber** who lived by the river was **stranded** when the bridge washed away, unable to reach his family. Aarav could not **resist** helping; she began a **hasty** search of the hillside for a safe path to guide him home.

parts.title: The Discovery
parts.text: On the hillside, Aarav found something remarkable — a hollow tree full of old coins that shone even in the grey storm light. She called Yuki, an **expert** healer from the next village, who had come to help after the flood. Chloe gave Aarav her best **advice**: share the **plentiful** coins with those whose homes had been destroyed.

parts.title: The Lesson
parts.text: Aarav nursed the bird for seven days, following a careful schedule and using herbs her grandmother taught her about. When the bird finally spread its wings and soared into the sky, the whole village cheered. The elder Chloe smiled and said, "The greatest strength is gentleness. Even the most delicate creature can survive the worst storm if someone cares enough to help." Aarav never forgot that lesson. She grew up to become the village healer, and people traveled from far away to seek her superb care.
